_note: GenerateImage calls. The parent runs the tool. Each reference_image_paths entry is relative to the repository root, and the first image is the piece's own crop. Keep and the portal keep the base in the crop: the stock 'no ground' sentence is replaced so the arch is not a floating ring and a rank is not a different keep. Terrain boxes on theme.jpg: {'plaza': [680, 608, 760, 680], 'path': [590, 540, 680, 630], 'dirt': [610, 555, 670, 615], 'ford': [595, 548, 650, 615], 'river': [1140, 640, 1260, 710], 'hill': [900, 56, 1260, 86], 'mountain': [900, 42, 1260, 70]}. The forest barrier strip on disk does not tile (variant a has 2 opaque pixels on each side edge, variant b has 4 and 8). Variant c is one outer-ring pitch, 90 px at a 110 px pine. Reeds wait until the river tile exists. Birds stay deferred. Fish stay dropped. Rabbits stay dropped. Do not build a keep or portal sheet from the views these calls replace.
